originalTitle: Stock Market Today, Aug. 5: Uber Falls 5% on Weak Guidance Despite Strong Bookings Growth
summary: On Aug. 5, 2026, the ride-hailing giant's profit outlook disappointed investors even as gross bookings surged 24% and revenue hit $14.2 billion.
